performance.measurement_notes: One-variable performance canary for GLM-5.2-FP8 PP13. This keeps the 262k dense TRITON_MLA direct-vLLM launch envelope and changes only FP8 MoE from Marlin to Triton so rank logs and throughput can confirm whether the SM12 path escapes weight-only Marlin. Live DSAPI decode-heavy sweeps on 2026-06-20 found 96-wide admission best among tested cohorts: 80x16->256 reached 103.8 aggregate tok/s, 96x16->256 reached 138.9 aggregate tok/s, 104x16->256 fell to 119.2 aggregate tok/s, and 112x16->256 reached 128.4 aggregate tok/s. Keep the Triton canary DSAPI cohort at 96 while native SM120 FP8 block-MoE work remains open.
performance.target: 13-stage GLM-5.2-FP8 frontier pipeline with Triton FP8 MoE canary and 96-wide DSAPI decode admission.

quality.baseline: Canary only. Compare smoke correctness and throughput against glm52_fp8_pp13_frontier_v1 before promotion.
